technology_name: Natural Fibre Production Bioprocess from Agro Waste
institution: CSIR-National Institute for Interdisciplinary Science and Technology (NIIST)
technology_type: Process Technology, Biological Resource, Waste/Resource Recovery System
problem_solved: Environmental pollution and long processing times associated with traditional fibre extraction from agro waste.
description: An anaerobic bioprocess for the production of natural fibre from agro waste. The technology utilizes retting tanks in parallel and an anaerobic reactor to extract coir, banana, and pineapple fibres while generating biogas as a value-added by-product in a zero-discharge system.
applications: Accelerated processing of natural coir fiber ,Rapid extraction of agricultural banana and pineapple fibers ,Anaerobic generation of industrial and municipal biogas fuel , Treatment and resource recovery of agricultural biomass waste
secondary_sector: Energy, Climate & Sustainability, Agribusiness & Rural Economy
